blocks.p: The *Crafting* tab of the *World* window lists the recipes you can make and opens one at a time. The list is at the left; the recipe you click opens at the right. The controls of the tab are listed in Table 27-1.

table.label: Table 27-1
table.title: The controls of the Crafting tab
head: Control
What it does
rows: Picks the station to craft at.
Picks a category of recipes to look through.
Finds recipes by name, category or ingredient.
*Ready* lists only what you can make now; *Known* and *All* list more.
Makes the recipe. The number beside it, set with *-* and *+*, is how many.

blocks.p: The open recipe gives its name, *Known* when you have learned it, how long it takes, and the *Required* list of everything it needs. A red square marks what is missing. A green square in the list marks a recipe you can make now.

blocks.note: *Craft* stays dimmed while a red square shows in the *Required* list.

caption: Figure 27-1
The Crafting tab, with a recipe open.

blocks.p: In Figure 27-1 the recipe *Add Cigarette to Pack* is open. It is known and takes 25 seconds, but both things it needs are missing.

marks.text: Pick the station to craft at, and a category to look through.
Search by name, category or ingredient.
A green square marks a recipe you can make now.
Sort by Craftable, Known, Name, Freq or Recent.
Show: Ready lists only what you can make now. The pop-up also has Known and All.
Craft stays dimmed while red squares show in the Required list.
